feed.title: Diamond Dog updates
feed.subtitle: Dated notes on what changed, what the experiment showed, and what is still unknown.

entry.title: Diamond Dog has a public page.
entry.content:
The design is written down. A first experiment is under way: we’re testing the design on an existing platform before building anything of our own. Nothing has shipped, and there is nothing to install yet.

The next note will say what the experiment showed, including what it didn’t settle.
